limits: ELF STT_FUNC sizes describe compiled relocated code, not original firmware coverage. They include local/runtime/veneer symbols and cannot be divided by original payload bytes as source completion.

The explicit original-entry map is a partial audit of selected initializer/kernel helpers; missing mappings do not imply absent source. Original function extents must be separately recovered before reporting deduplicated implemented original bytes.
Source instruction trace coverage and implementation ownership are separate. Passing comparisons do not prove all branches or source/byte completion.
